name: youtube-downloader-agent
description: Pinned external C# control/treatment tasks for product proof.

tasks.prompt: Explain how YoutubeDownloader selects a download option, includes subtitles, configures FFmpeg, and reports progress. Cite the implementation files and exact line ranges.

tasks.description: Trace likely impact of changing the download operation.
tasks.prompt: Trace the likely impact of changing VideoDownloader.DownloadVideoAsync. Explain the dashboard orchestration, settings that affect the call, and post-download tagging behavior. Cite implementation files and exact line ranges.

tasks.description: Select authoritative validation for a download-path change.
tasks.prompt: Identify the repository-authoritative validation commands for a change to the download pipeline, distinguish build from formatting and packaging checks, and cite exact file line ranges. Do not invent a test project.
